tabs.html:
D CORE 5dB Fiber Optic Attenuator LC/UPC Male to Female Singlemode (SM)


The D CORE 5dB LC/UPC Male to Female Fiber Optic Attenuator is engineered for precise optical signal control in singlemode fiber networks. Designed to reduce signal power without introducing significant loss or distortion, this high-performance attenuator is ideal for protecting sensitive equipment from optical overload.


Key Features:

  • Reliable 5dB Fixed Attenuation – Delivers consistent signal reduction for optimal performance
  • Connector Type: LC/UPC male to female for easy plug-and-play integration
  • Singlemode Compatibility: Supports long-distance high-bandwidth applications
  • Low Insertion Loss & High Return Loss: Maintains signal integrity with minimal interference
  • Durable Construction: Built with premium materials to ensure stability and long-term use


Applications:

  • Telecom and broadband networks
  • Data centers and server rooms
  • CATV and FTTH systems
  • Lab testing and fiber optic measurement
